snippet.title: Pop Breaker [ポップブレイカー] Game Sample - Game Gear
snippet.description:
Pop Breaker is a simple, but functional old Game Gear game from Micro Cabin; they developed various games such as the Riglord Saga games, Guardian War, Xak, etc.

The game is a shooting puzzler; there aren't a wide variety of power-ups to boost your shot powers, but there are various obstacles on the stage that can work for you (or against you). For example, you can shoot reflective blocks that bounce your shots around the room. You can look around the stages and think of the best way to finish the level based on the enemies and stage layouts. Enemies function differently, adding to the puzzle.

Interestingly, you can choose which side your gun will fire with Daiana; Left, Center, and Right. It may sound strange, but there are certain circumstances which will make having the gun mounted on the right more convenient than on the left. Generally speaking, they all help in various circumstances, though center shot acts as a "balanced" shot type. The game has some very nice artwork pictures (for the Game Gear) and the Micro Cabin girl on the game's start-up is meant to resemble the "Adventure" genre identifier on Game Gear (Typically Japanese) boxes.

NOTE: The floor does not disappear when you are scrolling in Look Mode; this is only occurring due to video interpolation added during the editing of this video; interpolation was used to keep aspects of the game that moved at 60FPS; This was done to retain the sense of speed.
